import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def report_viewer() -> None:
    script = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "report_viewer.py"
    subprocess.run(["streamlit", "run", str(script)], check=True)


def snapshot_eval() -> None:
    subprocess.run(["streamlit", "run", "pkg/entrypoints/snapshot_eval.py"], check=True)

cases.name: runnable package files no file imports

cases.name: files the package's own CLI runs by path are used (report_viewer, snapshot_eval)
a module string or a console script entry marks the file used
a path named only in a docstring or by a test leaves the file a candidate
